subject: Access provenance checklist & SCIM sampling timeline
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@valencehealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: security@valencehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00Z
Subject: Access provenance for tenant VAL-923 — initial ask

Hi Soojin,

Hope you27re well. We27re working through our SIG questionnaire and hit the Access Control / Provisioning section for the VAL-923 tenant. To complete our review we need:

- A small SCIM delta sample (CSV or export) showing 7 days of provisioning events for VAL-923 (create/update/deprovision)
- One example SAML assertion (redacted) for a recent interactive login tied to an admin role
- A short walk-through doc describing how RBAC maps to groups/roles in SCIM and any least-privilege pruning cadence you maintain

Can you confirm what the fastest way is to get these artifacts? We27re on a tight compliance window and would like to keep this scoped to minimal PII.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Senior Information Security Analyst
Valence Health

---

Note: VAL-923 is the tenant id for our pilot environment. If you need a PO or secure transfer method let us know and we27ll open the ticket on our side.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@valencehealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Access provenance for tenant VAL-923 — initial ask

Thanks Oliver — we can provide all three items. High-level plan below, let me know if any part needs to be narrower (we can redact emails/ids).

Planned deliverables and timeline:
- SCIM delta sample: 7-day CSV export (created/updated/deprovision events) for VAL-923. We will redact email addresses and include role/group assignment changes. ETA: 48 hours.
- SAML assertion sample: one recent assertion with identifying attributes redacted (name/email replaced with placeholders). ETA: 24 hours.
- RBAC mapping doc: 1-page mapping that shows group -> role -> privilege and our monthly least-privilege sweep cadence. ETA: 72 hours.

Transfer options: secure SFTP or a shared Drive link (we can set a tenant-scoped folder and expire link after 14 days). If you require DocuSign or an encrypted bundle, flag it and we27ll escalate.

I27m looping in Priyom (compliance lead) and Marcus (infra/SCIM owner) to prepare the extracts.

Next steps: Oliver, please confirm preferred transfer method and whether we should redact email addresses entirely or pseudonymize them.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs referenced: scim-delta-sample.csv (placeholder), saml-assertion-sample.txt (placeholder)

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-16T12:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Access provenance for tenant VAL-923 — internal coordination

Thanks Soojin — quick notes from compliance:

- Redaction policy: redact PII (emails, names) and replace with consistent placeholders (user_##) so Valence can follow event flows without real identifiers.
- For the SCIM export, include a separate column that indicates the role assignment delta (previous_role -> new_role) so reviewers can confirm RBAC changes.
- Provide a short README in the Drive folder that explains column names and the clock timezone.

Marcus, can you pull a 7-day delta from the provisioning logs for tenant VAL-923 and scrub according to policy? Also confirm whether the deprovision events include a linked service-account fingerprint.

Priyom

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T15:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Access provenance for tenant VAL-923 — extracts uploaded

Uploaded the artifacts to a tenant-scoped Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/valence/SCIM-delta-sample

Files included:
- scim-delta-sample.csv (7-day export; columns: timestamp,event_type,user_id,placeholder_id,previous_role,new_role,actor_type)
- saml-assertion-sample.txt (assertion redacted: name/email replaced with user_01; includes AuthnInstant and Issuer)
- access-ownership-roster.xlsx (mapping of groups -> roles -> owners; last reviewed 2026-07-12)
- README.txt (column map, timezone: UTC, redaction notes)

Notes on service accounts: our deprovision events include service_account_id where applicable; those are hashed (sha256) in the export. If Valence needs raw ids for an audit, we will require a secure transfer agreement.

Oliver — I27ve set the folder to expire in 14 days and added a viewer restriction to your domain. If you27d prefer SFTP, tell me and I27ll provision a temporary account (we can also push via encrypted tar).

-Marcus
Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference
